geopolitics_summary: Iran sanctions reimposed; Russia refinery strikes; EU green rules under pressure from Italy and US lobbying.

themes.headline: Trump reimposes sanctions on Iranian oil sales
themes.why_it_matters: Tightens global crude, supporting Brent and reducing LNG feedstock availability. Higher energy costs boost EU power via fuel-switch to gas; TTF may rise if MENA LNG supply diverted to premium markets.

themes.headline: Russia halts diesel exports after Ukrainian refinery strikes
themes.why_it_matters: Refinery capacity loss constrains Russian refined product exports; potential spillover to EU via crude-for-product swaps and tighter global supply. Indirect pressure on EU generation fuel economics.

themes.headline: Italy leads push to weaken EU green rules in €2 trillion budget
themes.why_it_matters: Weakening green criteria risks delaying renewable deployment and carbon reduction targets. Slower decarbonization trajectory extends thermal baseload demand; lower EUA floor support. Policy uncertainty affects Cal+1 carbon forwards.

themes.headline: EU shipyard services Putin's LNG fleet ahead of sanctions
themes.why_it_matters: Maintaining Russian LNG fleet operability sustains Nord Stream LNG supply to Asia and indirectly supports global LNG spot prices. Lower LNG costs reduce EU gas-to-power switching incentive; TTF downside risk via arbitrage relief.

themes.headline: US oil executives lobby Trump to attack Europe's climate rules
themes.why_it_matters: US political pressure on EU ETS and climate rules risks dilution or delay; lower carbon credibility weakens EUA floor. Transatlantic regulatory friction may stall CBAM enforcement, reducing EU carbon leverage and power cost support.

watchlist: EU green rules decision next week (Sweden/Italy standoff); monitor EUA and renewable subsidy signals.
Iran sanctions impact on global crude and LNG arbitrage into NW Europe TTF.
Russian refinery strike damage assessment; diesel export resumption timeline.
NATO pipeline cost resolution; potential EU fuel transport constraint implications.
